'''January 2001 Fitchburg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fitchburg, MA on 20 January 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1650">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-fitchburg-ma-1-20-01d1650/ fitchburg-ma-1-20-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-fitchburg-ma-1-20-01d1650/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Fitchburg, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
